changes: Reserve a separate 8 MiB typed-worker protocol component before assigning session/prover RAM; validate it before process launch and preserve it across preprocessing-cache reconfiguration.

Bound the overlap of the received job frame and result capacity with request metadata, policy/context transitions, fixed identities and launch controls. Reject oversized capacities before publication.

Normalize PolicyContext into 64 fixed inline slots, discarding caller spare capacity before publication and retaining no heap owner. Encode the unchanged policy wire format into exactly reserved backing.
Include the same 8 MiB component in Python worker admission for both witness and hybrid profiles without changing witness or managed-GPU geometry.
Update shared CPU lifecycle fixtures to include the protocol allowance and repair the Python exact-fit fixture to leave the admitted protocol memory available.

preliminary_revisions.reason: Successful initial compile before refining the policy-decode backing census and extending the Python protocol reserve to hybrid profiles.
All 16 native lifecycle/storage cases passed with the final Rust sources. Only the Python exact-fit fixture changed afterwards; the archive preserves that earlier fixture.
The existing exact-fit test assigned every worker byte to heap before adding the new protocol reserve. Its boundary now subtracts that reserve; all 62 Python tests pass in controller-02.log.

limitations: The protocol envelope is logical ownership accounting and includes conservative overlap with separately reserved inline session storage. It is not an RSS estimate or throughput claim.

Proof object heaps, borrowed caller-owned input backing, coordinator pending assignments/results and queues, engine initialization/per-job owners, driver/allocator/OS storage and thread stacks retain separate obligations. Complete worker/coordinator phase composition remains open.
PolicyContext construction normalizes incoming spare capacity; arbitrary caller-owned construction storage is not charged as retained context storage.
Ordinary pool admission still rejects incomplete versioned phase profiles. Descriptors must be regenerated with the additional 8 MiB host component; physical service limits are unchanged.

Full-size proofs use the research wide OpenCL path with one retained program. Nonempty-child full-size merges, broader workloads and live-cache sets, paired comparisons, 24 hours AND 150 completed roots, multiple GPUs and AMD/Metal qualification remain required.
Verification stays on CPU; proof encodings, policy wire bytes, parameters and arithmetic activation are unchanged.
